content:
name: EOS trace projection repair

# Temporary repair workflow. Final regeneration pass includes the permanent
# repair review artifact before this workflow is removed.
on:
  push:
    branches: [eos/trace-projection-integrity]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/eos-trace-projection-repair.yml'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  repair:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Regenerate deterministic trace projection
        run: python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write
      - name: Regenerate machine documents
        run: python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
      - name: Commit derived projection repair
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .eos/trace-edges.tsv machine
          if git diff --cached --quiet --exit-code; then
            echo 'No derived changes required.'
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "fix(eos): regenerate deterministic trace projection"
          git push origin "HEAD:${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
